slides.title: Buying The Broadcasted Support Floor
slides.card_text: Retail traders view the broadcasted 23,750 support zone as a guaranteed floor for mean reversion. In reality, institutions use predictable technical support levels during global sell-offs as exit liquidity to match retail buy-limit orders against overnight short hedges.

slides.title: How Liquidity Is Quietly Extracted
slides.card_text: When GIFT Nifty trades lower, retail limit orders stacked around the 23,750 level absorb institutional sell flow. Smart money dumps risk onto eager retail dip-buyers before price breaks down further, turning technical support into a high-density trap.

slides.title: Order Flow And Exit Liquidity
slides.card_text: Market makers exploit predictable technical zones. By filling passive retail buy orders at the 23,750 support, institutional desks transfer overnight gap risk. Retail traders end up holding underwater positions while institutional portfolios remain Delta-neutral or net short.

slides.title: Measuring The Hidden Rupee Erosion
slides.card_text: Catching falling knives at static support burns capital fast. Entering at 23,750 without volume validation leads to average drawdown spirals of 1.8% to 3.2% per gap-down session, compounding severe long-term portfolio drag over multiple trade cycles.

slides.title: The 30-Minute Execution Rule
slides.card_text: Never place limit buy orders at technical support zones like 23,750 during global sell-offs. Wait for at least 30 minutes of post-open spot volume confirmation to ensure institutional buyers have absorbed supply before committing fresh capital.

slides.title: The Pre-Trade Audit Protocol
slides.card_text: Before buying any support level near 23,750, verify three factors: confirm GIFT Nifty arbitrage spreads, audit spot market opening volume over 30 minutes, and check institutional FII cash segment net flow to avoid liquidity traps.
